s1.syndrome_frame: Acute presentation with altered mental status and cardiovascular instability
salient_findings: Bradycardia with pulse rate in the 20s
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 80s
Presented to the emergency department with altered mental status
Experienced weakness, slurred speech, emesis, and headache
Initial blood pressure was 100/73 mm Hg
Initial heart rate was 49 beats/min
Initial respiratory rate was 27 breaths/min
Oxygen saturation was 95% on a nonrebreather mask
Required intubation for airway protection
Computed tomography of the head showed no acute pathology
Chest radiography showed pulmonary consolidation
Electrocardiogram showed intrinsic junctional rhythm at rate of about 60 beats/min

shortlist.label: Severe sepsis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with altered mental status, weakness, and pulmonary consolidation, which are consistent with severe sepsis.

shortlist.label: Myocardial infarction
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's initial heart rate was 49 beats/min and electrocardiogram showed intrinsic junctional rhythm, which could be indicative of myocardial infarction.

shortlist.label: Stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with altered mental status, weakness, and slurred speech, which are consistent with stroke.

shortlist.label: Pulmonary embolism
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with pulmonary consolidation and cardiovascular instability, which could be indicative of pulmonary embolism.

shortlist.label: Status epilepticus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with altered mental status and required intubation for airway protection, which could be indicative of status epilepticus.

rule_out.why: age and sex are not specific to any diagnosis

rule_in.why: altered mental status is a common presenting symptom

rule_out.why: altered mental status is less typical for pulmonary embolism

rule_in.why: weakness is a common presenting symptom of stroke
it often presents with slurred speech

rule_out.why: it is less commonly associated with slurred speech
emesis is less typical for myocardial infarction

rule_in.why: headache is a common symptom of stroke

trace.fact: Vital sign: pulse rate in the 20s

rule_in.why: pulse rate in the 20s is not typical for any candidate

rule_out.why: pulse rate in the 20s is not typical for any of these conditions but is most incompatible with all of them as they generally present with tachycardia

trace.fact: Vital sign: blood pressure of 100/73 mm Hg

rule_out.why: normal blood pressure is not discriminatory
